pad_gate_0p015.note: This is the W2 integration-benchmark gate, not the substrate contract gate.
pad_gate_0p015.mechanism: IK model residual is ~0.001 m, but the base drifted ~0.055 m in x during the 0.35 s ramp + 0.2 s hold (base x 1.433 -> 1.378) and the object was pushed ~0.065 m in y; the executed site error is dominated by base motion, not the solve.

caveats: arm_pose_ik.run() sets its own ok flag with worst_pad_error <= 0.015, i.e. it applies the W2 pad gate inside the substrate. The substrate contract's hard gate is joint_margin >= 0.05 rad, which passes; downstream should read pad_error as a report, not the substrate ok flag.
pad_error is measured from the palm site (the solve target) while the normal error is measured from the gripper pad geom; the two use different reference points.
verdict_reason: All substrate contract checks pass: 12-D two-palm solve, waist_owner=homie and measured exogenous, solver=mink-qp with a DLS fallback path, joint_margin_min 0.3705 (generic) / 0.975 (custom) far above 0.05 rad, and pad position/normal error plus a binding constraint reported.
